decisions.reason: The platform height and footprint do not change the required bowl-removal, swapping, or cleaning-clearance behavior.
The 5.5-inch platform height concerns cup clearance beneath the spouts, not whisk size, attachment, or operating depth within the bowls.
The source specifies platform geometry but does not require a revised BOM, reopen the approved component set, or change the current parts-list deliverable.
The platform color and font-color requirements were already established in message 128; message 130 changes only height, cup clearance, and footprint fit.
Raising the machine for cup clearance does not change the existing splash-control target or mitigation methods.
The source does not change machine wording, placard placement, or the sides on which branding appears.
The 12-ounce size refers to serving cups beneath the spouts, not the capacity or form of the matcha mixing bowls.
The platform dimensions and edge-to-edge fit do not alter the established DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The client confirms a raised base after the freelancer states that it requires additional custom fabrication, expanding the V1 custom-fabrication exception beyond the spouts.
